chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Fudayl, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both):
That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to pray thirteen rak'ahs after the middle of the night.

key_terms.يَنْتَصِفُ اللَّيْلَ: after the middle of the night

ai.seo_question: How many units of prayer did the Prophet perform after the middle of the night?
ai.summary: This narration from the Tahdhib al-Ahkam, transmitted through the chain of Ibn Abi Umayr, establishes the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) consistent practice of performing thirteen rak'ahs of night prayer (Tahajjud) after midnight. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as the primary evidentiary basis for the recommended number of units in the night prayer, distinguishing it from the Witr prayer while highlighting the Prophet's devotion to the Qiyam al-Layl. The specificity of 'thirteen' underscores the Sunnah's role in guiding the structure of voluntary worship beyond the obligatory five daily prayers.
